supportedRuntimes.description: Runtime routes verified for this registered project. Feature compatibility is checked during registration and matrix generation.

vipcPath.description: One checkout-relative VI Package Configuration (.vipc), installed with vipm install before vipm lock.

sparsePaths.description: SVN only: check out the repository root with --depth empty and fetch only these checkout-relative directories (parents become empty directories).

patches.description: Native and container Windows pipelines: unified diffs (paths relative to the checkout root, e.g. from `svn diff`) applied to the fresh checkout before any VIPM step, with `svn patch` or `git apply`. Relative patch paths resolve against the pipeline repository root. A patch that does not apply cleanly fails the project, and each applied patch is recorded as a checkout:patch SBOM property. The Linux container rejects this setting.

sourceCheckouts.description: Native Windows only: Git repositories required by the project, checked out under its fresh working directory before VIPM commands.

checkoutPath.description: Safe relative path inside the primary project checkout.

windowsContainerNipmFeeds.description: Windows container only: explicitly provision these NI feed aliases/URLs before installing manifest NI build prerequisites. Native runners ignore this field and retain separately provisioned feeds.

build.description: Opt in to building with VIPM. packages = true builds every type = "vipb" [build.<name>] target of vipm.toml in depends-on order, installs each .vip before its dependents and vipm lock, and reports it as a pkg:vipm component. sbomPath with artifactPath runs vipm build --all and includes its generated SBOM and Authenticode-verified artifact. The Linux container skips builds with a warning.

lvlibpDependencies.description: Published immutable GitHub LVLIBP releases verified by signed release attestation and staged relative to the SandboxSBOMReporting checkout root before any VIPM command.

stagePath.description: Safe relative path from the SandboxSBOMReporting checkout root, not the module checkout.

labviewVersion.description: LabVIEW year that every vipm command uses for this project, written to `.vipm/config.toml` next to vipm.toml before the first vipm call. Overrides the manifest's labview-version (for example, build 2024 code with LabVIEW 2026).

labviewBitness.description: LabVIEW bitness written to `.vipm/config.toml` with labviewVersion (default: the manifest's labview-bitness, else 64).
